# GSAP runtime files

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, vendored unchanged from the gsap npm distribution:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Copyright and license references are retained in each file's header.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Only the homepage loads these files. Keeping them local avoids a runtime CDN dependency.
